result.reason: The operative language includes all preferred coverages and limits: CGL at $1M per occurrence/$2M aggregate, E&O at $2M, conditional cyber/privacy at $5M, statutory workers’ compensation, and certificates on request. It preserves the existing representation-by-counsel provision and is professionally drafted. However, it goes beyond the playbook by requiring all coverage for one year after the term and by triggering cyber coverage for access to any Confidential Information, rather than only processing Customer Data.
